    q(a),

    file('/tmp/HKdDPqQXpc/SOT_YCnkLK',a2) ).

    ~ q(a),
    inference(assume_negation,[status(cth)],[c]) ).

    ~ q(a),
    inference(fof_simplification,[status(thm)],[c_0_3]) ).

fof(c_0_5,negated_conjecture,
    ~ q(a),
    inference(fof_nnf,[status(thm)],[c_0_4]) ).

fof(c_0_6,plain,
    ! [X2] :
      ( ~ p(X2)
      | q(X2) ),
    inference(fof_nnf,[status(thm)],[inference(variable_rename,[status(thm)],[inference(fof_nnf,[status(thm)],[a1])])]) ).

cnf(c_0_7,negated_conjecture,
    ~ q(a),
    inference(split_conjunct,[status(thm)],[c_0_5]) ).

cnf(c_0_8,plain,
    ( q(X1)
    | ~ p(X1) ),
    inference(split_conjunct,[status(thm)],[c_0_6]) ).

cnf(c_0_9,plain,
    p(a),
    inference(split_conjunct,[status(thm)],[a2]) ).

cnf(c_0_10,negated_conjecture,
    $false,
    inference(cn,[status(thm)],[inference(rw,[status(thm)],[inference(spm,[status(thm)],[c_0_7,c_0_8]),c_0_9])]),
    [proof] ).
